title: まみむめも・おへや の いちにち
jp: ま行 ・ gojuon row 7 ・ a day at home

render.trackName: おへや の いちにち

blurb: Row 7 of the gojuon — ま み む め も — through a cosy day at home: open the window, eat beans, a sweet mandarin and cold water, round glasses, a sweet peach and white mochi under a warm blanket. Say the thing, then use it. The home variation of three ま-row songs (home · nature · animals).
concept: Words alone blend (findings F-10), so every target sits in a small action — まど を あける, まめ を たべる, めだか が およぐ — and it recombines with earlier rows (あける, たべる, うさぎ, あまい, つめたい, あたたかい return), keeping the ladder (F-13).
The five-kana row ま み む め も closes every verse as the sung-together refrain (F-07). The 3-minute cut adds a day-at-home bridge and a sentences-only review, not a loop (F-12).
This is the home variation — small comforts of a day indoors, with a snack or two. Pairs with the Female (city pop) voice.
